headline: Waaree Renewable Technologies completes acquisition of Associated Power Structures Private Limited
sum: Waaree Renewable Technologies has closed its acquisition of Associated Power Structures Private Limited, a consolidation in India's renewable energy equipment manufacturing and solar structures supply chain.
detail: The acquisition completion was formally notified to the NSE on 18 June 2026 via intimation filing. Associated Power Structures Private Limited (formerly Associated Power Structures Limited) is being acquired as a wholly-owned subsidiary or merged entity. The target operates in solar structures/mounting systems, which are high-volume, essential components in solar EPC delivery. Waaree's integration is likely aimed at backward integration into mounting systems and supply-chain redundancy in India's renewable energy manufacturing ecosystem.
